Q1.en: Since \(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\), take the perpendicular as 3k and the base as 4k. Then the hypotenuse is \(\sqrt{9k^2 + 16k^2} = 5k\), so \(\cos\theta = \frac{4k}{5k} = \frac{4}{5}\), which is the choice \(\frac{4}{5}\).
Q1.hi: चूँकि \(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\), अतः लम्ब 3k और आधार 4k लेने पर कर्ण \(\sqrt{9k^2 + 16k^2} = 5k\) होगा। अतः \(\cos\theta = \frac{4k}{5k} = \frac{4}{5}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{4}{5}\) है।

Q2.en: A die has six equally likely outcomes, and three of them (2, 4, 6) are even. So the probability is \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{2}\).
Q2.hi: पासे के छह समप्रायिक परिणाम होते हैं, जिनमें से तीन (2, 4, 6) सम हैं। अतः प्रायिकता \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{2}\) है।

Q3.en: The total frequency is \(N = 7 + 8 + 15 + 10 + 5 = 45\), so \(\frac{N}{2} = 22.5\). The cumulative frequencies are 7, 15, 30, 40, 45, and the first one greater than 22.5 is 30, which belongs to the class 20-30. So the median class is 20-30.

Q4.en: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The highest frequency in the table is 11, for the class 10-15, so the modal class is 10-15.
Q4.hi: बहुलक वर्ग वह वर्ग है जिसकी बारंबारता सबसे अधिक हो। सारणी में सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 11 है, जो वर्ग 10-15 की है। अतः बहुलक वर्ग 10-15 है।

Q5.en: The probability of any event always lies between 0 and 1, that is \(0 \le P(E) \le 1\). So a probability can never be negative, and \(-1\) cannot be the probability of any event.
Q5.hi: किसी भी घटना की प्रायिकता सदैव 0 और 1 के बीच होती है, अर्थात् \(0 \le P(E) \le 1\)। अतः प्रायिकता कभी ऋणात्मक नहीं हो सकती, इसलिए \(-1\) किसी घटना की प्रायिकता नहीं हो सकती।

Q6.en: From \(3\cot A = 4\), \(\cot A = \frac{4}{3}\), so \(\tan A = \frac{3}{4}\) and \(\tan^2 A = \frac{9}{16}\). Then \(\frac{1 - \tan^2 A}{1 + \tan^2 A} = \frac{1 - \frac{9}{16}}{1 + \frac{9}{16}} = \frac{\frac{7}{16}}{\frac{25}{16}} = \frac{7}{25}\), which is the choice \(\frac{7}{25}\).

Q7.en: From the table of standard angles, \(\cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{2}\).
Q7.hi: मानक कोणों की सारणी से \(\cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{2}\) है।

Q8.en: Using the identities \(1 + \cot^2\theta = \text{cosec}^2\theta\) and \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\), the expression becomes \(\frac{\text{cosec}^2\theta}{\sec^2\theta} = \frac{\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta} = \cot^2\theta\), which is the choice \(\cot^2\theta\).
Q8.hi: सर्वसमिकाओं \(1 + \cot^2\theta = \text{cosec}^2\theta\) और \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\) से व्यंजक \(\frac{\text{cosec}^2\theta}{\sec^2\theta} = \frac{\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta} = \cot^2\theta\) हो जाता है, जो विकल्प \(\cot^2\theta\) है।

Q9.en: For two numbers, \(HCF \times LCM = \) product of the numbers. So \(HCF(35, 63) = \frac{35 \times 63}{315} = \frac{2205}{315} = 7\), which is the choice 7.
Q9.hi: दो संख्याओं के लिए \(HCF \times LCM = \) संख्याओं का गुणनफल। अतः \(HCF(35, 63) = \frac{35 \times 63}{315} = \frac{2205}{315} = 7\), जो विकल्प 7 है।

Q10.en: Writing each number as a product of primes: \(12 = 2^2 \times 3\), \(15 = 3 \times 5\), \(21 = 3 \times 7\). The LCM takes the highest power of each prime: \(2^2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 7 = 420\), which is the choice 420.
Q10.hi: प्रत्येक संख्या को अभाज्य गुणनखंडों में लिखने पर: \(12 = 2^2 \times 3\), \(15 = 3 \times 5\), \(21 = 3 \times 7\)। LCM में प्रत्येक अभाज्य की सबसे बड़ी घात ली जाती है: \(2^2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 7 = 420\), जो विकल्प 420 है।

Q11.en: The product is \(\sqrt{2}(2 - \sqrt{2}) = 2\sqrt{2} - 2\). Since \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational, \(2\sqrt{2}\) is irrational, and subtracting the rational number 2 keeps it irrational. So the product is an irrational number.
Q11.hi: गुणनफल \(\sqrt{2}(2 - \sqrt{2}) = 2\sqrt{2} - 2\) है। चूँकि \(\sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है, इसलिए \(2\sqrt{2}\) भी अपरिमेय है, और इसमें से परिमेय संख्या 2 घटाने पर भी यह अपरिमेय ही रहता है। अतः गुणनफल एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

Q12.en: By the distance formula, the distance is \(\sqrt{(4 - 2)^2 + (1 - 3)^2} = \sqrt{4 + 4} = \sqrt{8} = 2\sqrt{2}\), which is the choice \(2\sqrt{2}\).

Q13.en: The radius \(OP\) is perpendicular to the tangent \(PQ\), so triangle \(OPQ\) is right-angled at \(P\). Hence \(PQ = \sqrt{OQ^2 - OP^2} = \sqrt{144 - 25} = \sqrt{119}\) cm, which is the choice \(\sqrt{119}\) cm.
Q13.hi: त्रिज्या \(OP\) स्पर्श रेखा \(PQ\) पर लम्ब होती है, अतः त्रिभुज \(OPQ\) में \(P\) पर समकोण है। अतः \(PQ = \sqrt{OQ^2 - OP^2} = \sqrt{144 - 25} = \sqrt{119}\) सेमी, जो विकल्प \(\sqrt{119}\) सेमी है।

Q14.en: Since \(DE \parallel BC\), \(\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC\) (AA similarity), so \(\frac{AD}{AB} = \frac{DE}{BC}\). Here \(AB = AD + DB = 3 + 1.5 = 4.5\) cm, so \(\frac{3}{4.5} = \frac{4}{BC}\), giving \(BC = \frac{4 \times 4.5}{3} = 6\) cm, which is the choice 6 cm.
Q14.hi: चूँकि \(DE \parallel BC\), अतः \(\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC\) (AA समरूपता), इसलिए \(\frac{AD}{AB} = \frac{DE}{BC}\)। यहाँ \(AB = AD + DB = 3 + 1.5 = 4.5\) सेमी, अतः \(\frac{3}{4.5} = \frac{4}{BC}\), जिससे \(BC = \frac{4 \times 4.5}{3} = 6\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 6 सेमी है।

Q15.en: Area of a sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \pi \times 6^2 = \frac{1}{6} \times 36\pi = 6\pi\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice \(6\pi\) cm\(^2\).
Q15.hi: त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \pi \times 6^2 = \frac{1}{6} \times 36\pi = 6\pi\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प \(6\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q16.en: Joining the two cubes gives a cuboid of length 20 cm, breadth 10 cm and height 10 cm. Its surface area is \(2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(20 \times 10 + 10 \times 10 + 10 \times 20) = 2(200 + 100 + 200) = 1000\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice 1000 cm\(^2\).
Q16.hi: दोनों घनों को मिलाने पर लम्बाई 20 सेमी, चौड़ाई 10 सेमी और ऊँचाई 10 सेमी का घनाभ बनता है। इसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(20 \times 10 + 10 \times 10 + 10 \times 20) = 2(200 + 100 + 200) = 1000\) सेमी\(^2\) है, जो विकल्प 1000 सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q17.en: Write the polynomial in standard form and split the middle term: \(6x^2 - 7x - 3 = 6x^2 - 9x + 2x - 3 = 3x(2x - 3) + 1(2x - 3) = (3x + 1)(2x - 3)\). So the zeroes are \(\frac{3}{2}\) and \(-\frac{1}{3}\), which is the choice \(\frac{3}{2}, -\frac{1}{3}\).

Q18.en: Here \(\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{4/3}{2} = \frac{2}{3}\), \(\frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{2}{3}\) and \(\frac{c_1}{c_2} = \frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\). Since \(\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2}\), the lines are coincident and the pair has infinitely many solutions.

Q19.en: Here \(a = 3\), \(b = -4\sqrt{3}\), \(c = 4\). The discriminant is \(b^2 - 4ac = (-4\sqrt{3})^2 - 4 \times 3 \times 4 = 48 - 48 = 0\), which is the choice 0.

Q20.en: The common difference is any term minus the term before it: \(d = (3 + \sqrt{2}) - 3 = \sqrt{2}\), which is the choice \(\sqrt{2}\).
Q20.hi: सार्व अन्तर किसी पद में से उसके पिछले पद को घटाने पर मिलता है: \(d = (3 + \sqrt{2}) - 3 = \sqrt{2}\), जो विकल्प \(\sqrt{2}\) है।

B1a.en:
Assume, on the contrary, that \(6\sqrt{3}\) is rational.

Then there exist co-prime integers \(a\) and \(b\) (\(b \neq 0\)) such that \(6\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b}\).

So \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{6b}\).

Since \(a\) and \(6b\) are integers and \(6b \neq 0\), \(\frac{a}{6b}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{3}\) would be rational.

But this contradicts the fact that \(\sqrt{3}\) is irrational. So the assumption is wrong.

Hence \(6\sqrt{3}\) is irrational.
B1a.hi:
इसके विपरीत मान लीजिए कि \(6\sqrt{3}\) परिमेय है।

तब ऐसे सहअभाज्य पूर्णांक \(a\) और \(b\) (\(b \neq 0\)) होंगे कि \(6\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b}\)।

अतः \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{6b}\)।

चूँकि \(a\) और \(6b\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(6b \neq 0\), इसलिए \(\frac{a}{6b}\) परिमेय है, अर्थात् \(\sqrt{3}\) परिमेय होगा।

परन्तु यह इस तथ्य का विरोधाभास है कि \(\sqrt{3}\) अपरिमेय है। अतः हमारी कल्पना गलत है।

अतः \(6\sqrt{3}\) अपरिमेय है।

B1c.en:
Let the \(Y\)-axis divide the segment joining \((5, -6)\) and \((-1, -4)\) in the ratio \(k : 1\). Any point on the \(Y\)-axis has \(x\)-coordinate 0.

By the section formula, the \(x\)-coordinate of the point of division is \(\frac{k(-1) + 1(5)}{k + 1}\).

So \(\frac{-k + 5}{k + 1} = 0\), which gives \(k = 5\).

Hence the required ratio is \(5 : 1\).

(The point of division is \(\left(0, \frac{5(-4) + 1(-6)}{6}\right) = \left(0, -\frac{13}{3}\right)\).)

B1d.en:
Multiply the numerator and the denominator inside the root by \((1 - \cos\theta)\):

\(\text{LHS} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)(1 - \cos\theta)}{(1 + \cos\theta)(1 - \cos\theta)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{1 - \cos^2\theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{\sin^2\theta}}\)

\(= \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \frac{1}{\sin\theta} - \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \text{cosec}\,\theta - \cot\theta = \text{RHS}\)

Hence proved.
B1d.hi:
मूल के अंदर अंश और हर दोनों को \((1 - \cos\theta)\) से गुणा करने पर:

\(\text{LHS} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)(1 - \cos\theta)}{(1 + \cos\theta)(1 - \cos\theta)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{1 - \cos^2\theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{\sin^2\theta}}\)

\(= \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \frac{1}{\sin\theta} - \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \text{cosec}\,\theta - \cot\theta = \text{RHS}\)

अतः सिद्ध हुआ।

B1e.en:
Area of the segment = area of the sector \(-\) area of the triangle formed by the chord and the two radii.

Area of the sector \(= \frac{120^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{3} \times 616 = \frac{616}{3} \approx 205.33\) cm\(^2\).

Area of the triangle \(= \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin 120^\circ = \frac{1}{2} \times 14 \times 14 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 49\sqrt{3} \approx 49 \times 1.732 = 84.87\) cm\(^2\).

Area of the segment \(= \left(\frac{616}{3} - 49\sqrt{3}\right)\) cm\(^2\) \(\approx 205.33 - 84.87 = 120.46\) cm\(^2\).
B1e.hi:
वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल = त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) जीवा और दोनों त्रिज्याओं से बने त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल।

त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{120^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{3} \times 616 = \frac{616}{3} \approx 205.33\) सेमी\(^2\)।

त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin 120^\circ = \frac{1}{2} \times 14 \times 14 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 49\sqrt{3} \approx 49 \times 1.732 = 84.87\) सेमी\(^2\)।

वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \left(\frac{616}{3} - 49\sqrt{3}\right)\) सेमी\(^2\) \(\approx 205.33 - 84.87 = 120.46\) सेमी\(^2\)।

B1f.en:
The total number of outcomes is 52.

(i) There are 2 red kings (the king of hearts and the king of diamonds). So \(P(\text{red king}) = \frac{2}{52} = \frac{1}{26}\).

(ii) There are 12 face cards (a king, a queen and a jack in each of the 4 suits). So \(P(\text{face card}) = \frac{12}{52} = \frac{3}{13}\).
B1f.hi:
कुल संभावित परिणाम 52 हैं।

(i) लाल रंग के बादशाह 2 हैं (पान का बादशाह और ईंट का बादशाह)। अतः \(P(\text{लाल बादशाह}) = \frac{2}{52} = \frac{1}{26}\)।

(ii) तस्वीर वाले पत्ते 12 हैं (चारों रंगों में से प्रत्येक में एक बादशाह, एक बेगम और एक गुलाम)। अतः \(P(\text{तस्वीर वाला पत्ता}) = \frac{12}{52} = \frac{3}{13}\)।

B2a.en:
Let \(O\) be the centre of the circle, and let \(OT\) cut the chord \(PQ\) at \(R\).

Since \(TP = TQ\) (tangents from an external point are equal) and \(OP = OQ\), \(\triangle OPT \cong \triangle OQT\) (SSS), so \(\angle PTR = \angle QTR\). Then \(\triangle TRP \cong \triangle TRQ\) (SAS), so \(PR = RQ\) and \(\angle TRP = \angle TRQ = 90^\circ\). Thus \(OT \perp PQ\) and \(PR = 2\) cm.

In right \(\triangle ORP\):
\(OR = \sqrt{OP^2 - PR^2} = \sqrt{(2.5)^2 - 2^2} = \sqrt{6.25 - 4} = \sqrt{2.25} = 1.5\) cm.

Let \(TR = y\) cm, so \(OT = y + 1.5\) cm.

In right \(\triangle TRP\): \(TP^2 = TR^2 + PR^2 = y^2 + 4\).

The radius is perpendicular to the tangent, so \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\). In right \(\triangle OPT\): \(OT^2 = OP^2 + TP^2\).

\((y + 1.5)^2 = 6.25 + y^2 + 4\)
\(y^2 + 3y + 2.25 = y^2 + 10.25\)
\(3y = 8 \Rightarrow y = \frac{8}{3}\)

So \(TP^2 = \left(\frac{8}{3}\right)^2 + 4 = \frac{64}{9} + \frac{36}{9} = \frac{100}{9}\).

Hence \(TP = \frac{10}{3}\) cm \(\approx 3.33\) cm.
B2a.hi:
माना वृत्त का केन्द्र \(O\) है, और \(OT\) जीवा \(PQ\) को बिन्दु \(R\) पर काटती है।

चूँकि \(TP = TQ\) (बाह्य बिन्दु से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाएँ बराबर होती हैं) और \(OP = OQ\), अतः \(\triangle OPT \cong \triangle OQT\) (SSS), इसलिए \(\angle PTR = \angle QTR\)। तब \(\triangle TRP \cong \triangle TRQ\) (SAS), अतः \(PR = RQ\) और \(\angle TRP = \angle TRQ = 90^\circ\)। इस प्रकार \(OT \perp PQ\) और \(PR = 2\) सेमी।

समकोण \(\triangle ORP\) में:
\(OR = \sqrt{OP^2 - PR^2} = \sqrt{(2.5)^2 - 2^2} = \sqrt{6.25 - 4} = \sqrt{2.25} = 1.5\) सेमी।

माना \(TR = y\) सेमी, तब \(OT = y + 1.5\) सेमी।

समकोण \(\triangle TRP\) में: \(TP^2 = TR^2 + PR^2 = y^2 + 4\)।

त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लम्ब होती है, अतः \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\)। समकोण \(\triangle OPT\) में: \(OT^2 = OP^2 + TP^2\)।

\((y + 1.5)^2 = 6.25 + y^2 + 4\)
\(y^2 + 3y + 2.25 = y^2 + 10.25\)
\(3y = 8 \Rightarrow y = \frac{8}{3}\)

अतः \(TP^2 = \left(\frac{8}{3}\right)^2 + 4 = \frac{64}{9} + \frac{36}{9} = \frac{100}{9}\)।

अतः \(TP = \frac{10}{3}\) सेमी \(\approx 3.33\) सेमी।

B2b.en:
Given: in \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) lies on \(AB\) and \(F\), \(E\) lie on \(BC\), with \(DE \parallel AC\) and \(DF \parallel AE\).

To prove: \(\frac{BF}{FE} = \frac{BE}{EC}\).

Proof: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(DE \parallel AC\). By the basic proportionality theorem,
\(\frac{BD}{DA} = \frac{BE}{EC}\) ... (1)

In \(\triangle ABE\), \(DF \parallel AE\). By the basic proportionality theorem,
\(\frac{BD}{DA} = \frac{BF}{FE}\) ... (2)

From (1) and (2), \(\frac{BF}{FE} = \frac{BE}{EC}\).

Hence proved.
B2b.hi:
दिया है: \(\triangle ABC\) में बिन्दु \(D\), \(AB\) पर तथा बिन्दु \(F\), \(E\), \(BC\) पर स्थित हैं, जहाँ \(DE \parallel AC\) और \(DF \parallel AE\)।

सिद्ध करना है: \(\frac{BF}{FE} = \frac{BE}{EC}\)।

उपपत्ति: \(\triangle ABC\) में \(DE \parallel AC\) है। आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से,
\(\frac{BD}{DA} = \frac{BE}{EC}\) ... (1)

\(\triangle ABE\) में \(DF \parallel AE\) है। आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से,
\(\frac{BD}{DA} = \frac{BF}{FE}\) ... (2)

(1) और (2) से, \(\frac{BF}{FE} = \frac{BE}{EC}\)।

अतः सिद्ध हुआ।

B2c.en:
Let the first term be \(a\) and the common difference be \(d\). We use \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\).

\(S_9 = \frac{9}{2}(2a + 8d) = 81 \Rightarrow 2a + 8d = 18 \Rightarrow a + 4d = 9\) ... (1)

\(S_{17} = \frac{17}{2}(2a + 16d) = 289 \Rightarrow 2a + 16d = 34 \Rightarrow a + 8d = 17\) ... (2)

Subtracting (1) from (2): \(4d = 8 \Rightarrow d = 2\).

From (1): \(a = 9 - 4 \times 2 = 1\).

Hence the first term is 1 and the common difference is 2.
B2c.hi:
माना प्रथम पद \(a\) और सार्व अन्तर \(d\) है। सूत्र \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\) से,

\(S_9 = \frac{9}{2}(2a + 8d) = 81 \Rightarrow 2a + 8d = 18 \Rightarrow a + 4d = 9\) ... (1)

\(S_{17} = \frac{17}{2}(2a + 16d) = 289 \Rightarrow 2a + 16d = 34 \Rightarrow a + 8d = 17\) ... (2)

(2) में से (1) घटाने पर: \(4d = 8 \Rightarrow d = 2\)।

(1) से: \(a = 9 - 4 \times 2 = 1\)।

अतः प्रथम पद 1 और सार्व अन्तर 2 है।

B2d.en:
\(x^2 - 5 = (x)^2 - (\sqrt{5})^2 = (x - \sqrt{5})(x + \sqrt{5})\).

So \(x^2 - 5 = 0\) when \(x = \sqrt{5}\) or \(x = -\sqrt{5}\). The zeroes are \(\alpha = \sqrt{5}\) and \(\beta = -\sqrt{5}\).

Verification: for \(x^2 + 0x - 5\), \(a = 1\), \(b = 0\), \(c = -5\).

Sum of zeroes \(= \sqrt{5} + (-\sqrt{5}) = 0\), and \(-\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{0}{1} = 0\).

Product of zeroes \(= \sqrt{5} \times (-\sqrt{5}) = -5\), and \(\frac{c}{a} = \frac{-5}{1} = -5\).

So sum of zeroes \(= -\frac{b}{a}\) and product of zeroes \(= \frac{c}{a}\). Hence the relationship is verified.

B2f.en:
Mode: the highest frequency is 23, so the modal class is 35-45.

\(l = 35\), \(h = 10\), \(f_1 = 23\), \(f_0 = 21\), \(f_2 = 14\).

Mode \(= l + \frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2} \times h = 35 + \frac{23 - 21}{46 - 21 - 14} \times 10 = 35 + \frac{20}{11} \approx 35 + 1.82 = 36.82\) years.

Median: make the cumulative frequency table.

| Age (in years) | Number of patients \((f)\) | Cumulative frequency \((cf)\) |
|---|---|---|
| 5-15 | 6 | 6 |
| 15-25 | 11 | 17 |
| 25-35 | 21 | 38 |
| 35-45 | 23 | 61 |
| 45-55 | 14 | 75 |
| 55-65 | 5 | 80 |

\(N = 80\), so \(\frac{N}{2} = 40\). The first cumulative frequency greater than 40 is 61, so the median class is 35-45.

\(l = 35\), \(cf = 38\), \(f = 23\), \(h = 10\).

Median \(= l + \frac{\frac{N}{2} - cf}{f} \times h = 35 + \frac{40 - 38}{23} \times 10 = 35 + \frac{20}{23} \approx 35 + 0.87 = 35.87\) years.

Hence the mode is about 36.82 years and the median is about 35.87 years.

B3a.en:
Let the tens digit be \(x\) and the units digit be \(y\). Then the number is \(10x + y\), and the number with the digits reversed is \(10y + x\).

Given that their sum is 88:
\((10x + y) + (10y + x) = 88 \Rightarrow 11x + 11y = 88 \Rightarrow x + y = 8\) ... (1)

The digits differ by 4, so either \(x - y = 4\) ... (2) or \(y - x = 4\) ... (3).

Case 1: from (1) and (2), adding gives \(2x = 12\), so \(x = 6\) and \(y = 2\). The number is \(10 \times 6 + 2 = 62\).

Case 2: from (1) and (3), adding gives \(2y = 12\), so \(y = 6\) and \(x = 2\). The number is \(10 \times 2 + 6 = 26\).

Check: \(62 + 26 = 88\) and \(6 - 2 = 4\).

Hence the number is 62 or 26, and there are two such numbers.

B3b.en:
Let the width of the field be \(x\) m. Then its length is \((2x + 9)\) m.

Area = length \(\times\) width, so
\(x(2x + 9) = 810\)
\(2x^2 + 9x - 810 = 0\)

Splitting the middle term (\(45 \times 36 = 1620 = 2 \times 810\) and \(45 - 36 = 9\)):
\(2x^2 + 45x - 36x - 810 = 0\)
\(x(2x + 45) - 18(2x + 45) = 0\)
\((x - 18)(2x + 45) = 0\)

So \(x = 18\) or \(x = -\frac{45}{2}\). A width cannot be negative, so \(x = 18\).

Length \(= 2 \times 18 + 9 = 45\) m.

Check: \(45 \times 18 = 810\) m\(^2\).

Hence the length of the field is 45 m and its width is 18 m.

B4a.en:
Let \(AB = h\) m be the tower, with foot \(B\) on the level ground. Let \(BC\) be the shadow when the sun's altitude is \(60^\circ\) and \(BD\) the shadow when it is \(30^\circ\), so \(CD = 30\) m. Let \(BC = x\) m, so \(BD = (x + 30)\) m.

In right \(\triangle ABC\):
\(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC} \Rightarrow \sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (1)

In right \(\triangle ABD\):
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AB}{BD} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x + 30} \Rightarrow x + 30 = \sqrt{3}h\) ... (2)

Putting (1) in (2):
\(\frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 30 = \sqrt{3}h\)
\(h + 30\sqrt{3} = 3h\)
\(2h = 30\sqrt{3}\)
\(h = 15\sqrt{3} = 15 \times 1.732 = 25.98\)

Hence the height of the tower is \(15\sqrt{3}\) m, that is 25.98 m.
B4a.hi:
माना मीनार \(AB = h\) मी है, जिसका आधार \(B\) समतल जमीन पर है। माना सूर्य का उन्नतांश \(60^\circ\) होने पर छाया \(BC\) है और \(30^\circ\) होने पर छाया \(BD\) है, अतः \(CD = 30\) मी। माना \(BC = x\) मी, तब \(BD = (x + 30)\) मी।

समकोण \(\triangle ABC\) में:
\(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BC} \Rightarrow \sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (1)

समकोण \(\triangle ABD\) में:
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AB}{BD} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x + 30} \Rightarrow x + 30 = \sqrt{3}h\) ... (2)

(1) को (2) में रखने पर:
\(\frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} + 30 = \sqrt{3}h\)
\(h + 30\sqrt{3} = 3h\)
\(2h = 30\sqrt{3}\)
\(h = 15\sqrt{3} = 15 \times 1.732 = 25.98\)

अतः मीनार की ऊँचाई \(15\sqrt{3}\) मी, अर्थात् 25.98 मी है।

B4b.en:
Divide the numerator and the denominator of the left-hand side by \(\cos\theta\):

\(\text{LHS} = \frac{\tan\theta - 1 + \sec\theta}{\tan\theta + 1 - \sec\theta} = \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - 1}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

In the numerator, replace 1 by \(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = (\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)\):

\(\text{LHS} = \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta) - (\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(1 - \sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta = \text{RHS}\)

Hence proved.
B4b.hi:
बाएँ पक्ष के अंश और हर को \(\cos\theta\) से भाग देने पर:

\(\text{LHS} = \frac{\tan\theta - 1 + \sec\theta}{\tan\theta + 1 - \sec\theta} = \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - 1}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

अंश में 1 के स्थान पर \(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = (\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)\) रखने पर:

\(\text{LHS} = \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta) - (\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(1 - \sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)

\(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta = \text{RHS}\)

अतः सिद्ध हुआ।

B5a.en:
The hemisphere rests on the top face of the cube, a square of side 14 cm. So its greatest possible diameter equals the side of the cube, that is 14 cm, and its radius is \(r = 7\) cm.

Surface area of the solid = total surface area of the cube \(-\) area of the base of the hemisphere \(+\) curved surface area of the hemisphere

\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)

\(= 6 \times 14 \times 14 + \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7\)

\(= 1176 + 154 = 1330\) cm\(^2\)

Hence the greatest diameter of the hemisphere is 14 cm, and the surface area of the solid is 1330 cm\(^2\).
B5a.hi:
अर्धगोला घन के ऊपरी फलक पर रखा है, जो 14 सेमी भुजा का वर्ग है। अतः अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास घन की भुजा के बराबर, अर्थात् 14 सेमी होगा, और उसकी त्रिज्या \(r = 7\) सेमी होगी।

ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = घन का सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(-\) अर्धगोले के आधार का क्षेत्रफल \(+\) अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल

\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)

\(= 6 \times 14 \times 14 + \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7\)

\(= 1176 + 154 = 1330\) सेमी\(^2\)

अतः अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास 14 सेमी है, और ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 1330 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B5b.en:
Radius of the cone and of the hemisphere \(r = 2\) cm; slant height of the cone \(l = 2\sqrt{2}\) cm.

Height of the cone: \(h = \sqrt{l^2 - r^2} = \sqrt{(2\sqrt{2})^2 - 2^2} = \sqrt{8 - 4} = 2\) cm.

Volume of the solid = volume of the cone + volume of the hemisphere

\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h + \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3\)

\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 2^2 \times 2 + \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 2^3\)

\(= \frac{8}{3}\pi + \frac{16}{3}\pi = 8\pi\)

\(= 8 \times 3.14 = 25.12\) cm\(^3\)

Hence the volume of the solid is 25.12 cm\(^3\).
B5b.hi:
शंकु और अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या \(r = 2\) सेमी; शंकु की तिर्यक ऊँचाई \(l = 2\sqrt{2}\) सेमी।

शंकु की ऊँचाई: \(h = \sqrt{l^2 - r^2} = \sqrt{(2\sqrt{2})^2 - 2^2} = \sqrt{8 - 4} = 2\) सेमी।

ठोस का आयतन = शंकु का आयतन + अर्धगोले का आयतन

\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h + \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3\)

\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 2^2 \times 2 + \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 2^3\)

\(= \frac{8}{3}\pi + \frac{16}{3}\pi = 8\pi\)

\(= 8 \times 3.14 = 25.12\) सेमी\(^3\)

अतः ठोस का आयतन 25.12 सेमी\(^3\) है।
